title: feat: E2B sandboxes through gen, paid in advance
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Alternative backend to #15251.

- Adds `/alpha/e2b` on gen, a pass-through of E2B's control API. E2B's SDKs and CLI work unchanged with `E2B_API_URL=https://gen.pollinations.ai/alpha/e2b` and a key with the new `machines` permission.
- Bills a prepaid lease on the sandbox timeout: each create, timeout or connect pays for the time past the running sandbox's current end. No refunds; pausing early gives up the rest. Launch promo: 25% of E2B's list price (`PRICE_MULTIPLIER`) until the promo ends.
- Keeps users apart on one E2B team: the owner is stored in sandbox metadata, each user can run 3 sandboxes, and `secure: true` is forced so envd needs the sandbox's access token.
- Adds `polli sandbox create | list | timeout | logs | kill`, and `ssh <id>.polli` with scp, sftp and rsync.
- Adds the default `pollinations` template (`operations/infrastructure/e2b/`): polli with Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, Hermes Agent and OpenClaw. Gen logs polli in with a `polli-sandbox-<id>` key, created through `POST /account/keys` with the caller's key. The first interactive ssh connects each harness with its own key.

Not in this PR: a dashboard sandbox section, Codex in the template (its router needs systemd), limits for keys created by keys (#16215).

Tested:
- On staging: E2B CLI 2.20.0 and JS/Python SDKs 2.51.0; wallet debits matched Tinybird. ssh, scp, sftp and rsync work; a paused sandbox resumes on ssh.
- The template on E2B's dev team: the first login connected all five harnesses in 27 s.

`E2B_API_KEY` (the dev E2B team's key, which has the `pollinations` template) is in gen's dev, staging and prod SOPS files, so promoting this PR makes `/alpha/e2b` live.

Before production:
- E2B's written consent to resell

gist.headline: A little room to compute
gist.blurb: Polli gets a sandbox with a door, a terminal, and five coding agents. Bring an E2B SDK or the polli CLI; the `pollinations` template has the tools waiting inside.
gist.summary: Adds `/alpha/e2b` for E2B-compatible sandboxes using keys with `machines` permission, prepaid leases at a launch price of 25% of E2B’s list price, and `polli sandbox` commands plus SSH access to a template with five coding agents.
gist.impact: Developers can use E2B’s CLI or JS/Python SDKs unchanged against the gen endpoint, or create and manage up to three secure sandboxes per user with `polli sandbox` and connect over SSH, scp, sftp or rsync.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the new E2B sandbox as a small, welcoming pixel-art workspace: a terminal, an SSH doorway, and five little toolstations for Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, Hermes Agent and OpenClaw. Polli, wearing a tiny tool belt, opens the doorway; lime-green code-plants make the computing space feel like part of the garden. Avoid inventing mascots or logos for the agent tools.
